devices.what: the work laptop's browser app shell (W.app, browser chrome, generic company account site), held across each chapter with W.resume; pages change with A.go, the camera zooms on each named control

the authenticator phone (kit part phone), standing to the right of the laptop shell; states: app home with Add account, camera framing the QR, account row with a six-digit code and a 30 s ring, missing, crossed out, and a second new phone
Sam's masked password as a small chip (kit part password_chip): typed in the hook, slips out of the leaked shop, comes back in b04, b06 and the payoff and is stopped at the code step
the teaching layer in accent2: chapter pills for the four chapters, the step pill per walkthrough step, and the numbered lost-phone path held on the left in b21 and b22
join material: handoff (the next chapter's window grows in) at b04, b14 and b24; a hard cut at b20 (the lost phone); continue inside a chapter

value_script.why: pale open on the quiet desk
slightly richer middle: zoomed walkthroughs, the lost-phone dim and the recovery path
lift at the close: the stopped attempt in a spotlight, the checklist ticked

parts.what: A generic smartphone in the screencast look (flat, surface body, field2 hairline, radius 28, soft offset lift, no brand), about 340 x 680 px at scale 1, standing to the right of the laptop window. Its screen is a generic authenticator app (no logo). States, switched on cue: off (dark screen); home (app title, empty list, an Add account button in accent); camera (a viewfinder with corner brackets, framing a QR drawn by qr_code); code (one account row with a six-digit code in large mono digits and a small countdown ring that runs down and refreshes to a new code about every 30 s, the ring time-driven); missing (only a dashed outline where the phone stood); crossed (the phone with a neg cross over it); new (a second instance, tagged as the new phone by position, same look). Must expose: draw at x,y,scale; state(name, t); tap(t) on a named button (a press ripple and an accent2 ring); setCode(digits, t); slide in and out.

A deterministic generic QR-like square (three finder squares and a seeded module pattern, ink on surface, never a real scannable payload) that can be drawn at any rect: on the laptop's setup dialog and inside the phone's camera viewfinder; fade in on cue.

Sam's password as a small pill: a key icon and eight masked dots in ink on surface with a hairline, about 260 x 56 px; can travel along a path, slip out of a window, be typed (dots appear one by one), crack (a split line) and be stopped (a neg outline with a short shake). The same chip in every beat that shows the leaked password.

design.why_motion: the same password going into two places is the whole hook
